name: Do Yeonjae
source:
Alicia is a potential love interest. When Taylor is kicked from her apartment for a month due to sudden renovations, Alicia is the one to give Taylor a change of clothes after she and her roommates accidentally hose her down due to playing around while washing their shared car, and bring her back to their flat to dry off.

From[url=https://maybeinteractive.fandom.com/wiki/Flower_Lane:_A_Record_of_Romance#Main] Maybe: Interactive Fandom Wiki
